 Dated this the 17th day of March, 2025  JUDGMENT
The writ petition is filed to direct the respondents 2 to 5 to release the margin money (subsidy) kept in the petitioner's Term Deposit Receipt (TDR) account to the petitioner's loan account.
2. The petitioner had started a unit of Bee keeping, manufacturing and processing of honey unit under Ext.P1 Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme ('PMEGP', in short).
The Government subsidy under the Scheme is directed to be routed through the Khadi and Village Industries Commission - the 2 nd respondent.

Once the margin money (subsidy) is received in the Sumesh C Sukumaran vs Union Of India on 17 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78589976/
2 bank in favour of the beneficiary, it is to be kept in a TDR account for three years in the name of the beneficiary.

sentences.text: The petitioner was entitled to Rs.8,65,789/- as subsidy, which was paid to the petitioner's TDR account on 10.03.2020.
The margin money has not been adjusted to the petitioner's loan account due to the delay in verification by the respondents.

The 5 th WP(C) NO.
4433 OF 2025 2025:KER:22640 respondent has classified the petitioner's bank account as NPA.
Yet, the subsidy kept in the TDR account is not adjusted to the petitioner's loan account.
The 4 th respondent has ignored the petitioner's demand for the above course.
The action on the part of the respondents is arbitrary.
Hence, the writ petition.

3. Heard; the learned counsel for the petitioner, the learned DSGI, the learned Standing Counsel appearing for the respondents 1 and 2, the learned Government Pleader and the learned counsel for the 5th respondent bank.
4.

Today when the writ petition was taken up for consideration, the learned counsel for the 2 nd respondent submitted that, the 2nd respondent has conducted the inspection and has forwarded a report to the 5 th respondent bank on 04.03.2025 certifying that the margin money of Rs.8,65,789/-
can be released to the petitioner's bank account.

He handed over a copy of the said proceedings,
which is accepted on board.

5. On a consideration of the facts and materials on record, particularly the report of the 2 nd respondent dated 04.03.2025, I am of the view that the writ petition is only to WP(C) NO. 4433 OF 2025 2025:KER:22640 be allowed.

In the aforesaid circumstances, I direct the 5th respondent bank, immediately on receipt of the proceedings dated 04.03.2025, to credit Rs.8,65,789/- to the petitioner's loan account for the purpose of adjusting the petitioner's liability.
The above exercise shall be carried out within a week from the date of receipt of the proceedings dated 04.03.2025.
The writ petition is ordered accordingly.

Sd/-
